# Supabase images the CI Database job uses with Supabase CLI 2.113.0 (pinned in ci.yml), pulled
# from GHCR (SUPABASE_INTERNAL_IMAGE_REGISTRY=ghcr.io) and cached between runs. Editing this file
# changes the cache key. After a CLI bump, run `supabase db start`, `supabase gen types --local`
# and `supabase test db` locally and copy the tags from `docker images`; CI fails if an image it
# used is missing here.
# The job's first CI run also pulled the last four (the CLI fetches them alongside the database).
ghcr.io/supabase/postgres:17.6.1.158
ghcr.io/supabase/postgres-meta:v0.96.8

ghcr.io/supabase/edge-runtime:v1.74.3
ghcr.io/supabase/gotrue:v2.195.0
ghcr.io/supabase/realtime:v2.124.2
ghcr.io/supabase/storage-api:v1.68.10
